children: Bionano’s revenue rose 12% year over year, while its net loss narrowed. Growth in instrument and consumables sales was partially offset by lower software revenue; lower selling, general and administrative expenses also contributed to the improved result.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share, basic and diluted”.
: Reached 398 systems as of September 30, 2026, up approximately 4% from 384 a year earlier.
: Sold 9,870 in the quarter, up approximately 18% from 8,390 in the same period of 2025.
: Instrument revenue increased 29% and consumables revenue rose 24%; software revenue decreased 31%.
: Total gross margin was 48%, compared with 46% in the same period of 2025; service and other gross margin was (42)%, versus 64%.

: Management said available cash and short-term investments were expected to fund operations into at least the first quarter of 2027, while substantial doubt about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern remained.
